purpose: Detect collisions with in-flight foundation PRs, shared files, ADR numbering, and naming.

adr.note: decisions.md is append-only; ADR-0054 is the next free number. Architecture spec (enhancements-architecture-spec.md) reserves ADR-0054 for the architecture decomposition itself — CONFIRM numbering at build time. If the architecture ADR lands first, this PR is ADR-0055. Resolve at PR time via session-wrapup; non-blocking for the spec.

F1_i18n_label_routing.collision_with_F6: NONE — F6 is a behaviour-preserving refactor that adds NO strings (all result/feedback strings already routed via t()). F6 must NOT touch i18n keys.

F2_board_input_a11y.collision_with_F6: POTENTIAL — both touch how the 3 components wire <Board>. F6 keeps each component's view/Board markup; only the loop logic moves out. Sequence so F2 and F6 don't both rewrite the same component's <Board> block in parallel.
F2_board_input_a11y.mitigation: F6 leaves <Board> markup + onMoveText untouched in each component (Play already has onMoveText; siblings don't). Do not add onMoveText to siblings in F6 (that is F2).

F5_games_store_pgn.collision_with_F6: LOW — Play's finishGame() persists via putGame; F6 keeps Play's persistence in Play's finishGame adapter, not in the shared core. F5 changes reads, not the write path F6 wraps.

shared_files_touched_by_F6.change: ADD stateful controller (or new sibling src/game/gameSession.ts) — existing pure helpers UNCHANGED
REPLACE inline loop with controller calls; keep view, clock rAF, coached UI, persistence adapter
DEFERRED to fast-follow (Q-D) — not migrated in this PR to bound blast radius

naming.recommendation: NEW sibling src/game/gameSession.ts for the stateful controller, leaving playSession.ts as the pure-helper home it is today (W12). Keeps 'pure' vs 'stateful' separation legible and avoids bloating the pure module. The controller imports the pure helpers.
naming.collision_check_AP_prefix: grep for 'AP-CTRL-' in repo = none found; prefix is free.

db_version.impact: NONE — pure refactor, no schema/persisted-field change. DB_VERSION untouched.

blast_radius_summary: F6 directly rewrites Play.svelte's internals (well-exercised in production but NOT covered by a component test). The mitigation is extraction into a DOM-free controller core with new parity unit tests BEFORE rewiring Play, plus the existing playSession + board-reactivity tests staying green. Sparring/Comeback migration deferred to a fast-follow (Q-D) so this PR's blast radius is Play-only.
